meta.title: Plugin suite
meta.description: Ten small local features in one bundle: file right-click copy, light/dark toggle, per-turn spend, hidden branch button, remembered unpinned panels, right sidebar open by default, one-click archive filter, Chinese approval cards, a sidebar restart button and in-session keyword search. Each has its own switch under Settings → Plugin suite, applied immediately. The configuration lives in ~/.dsh/plugin-suite.json.

settings.title: Plugin suite
settings.subtitle: Manage the ten independent features. Changes apply immediately.
settings.loadFailed: Could not read the configuration; showing the last cached switch state.
settings.saveFailed: Save failed; the switch was reverted.

artifact-copy.title: File right-click copy
artifact-copy.description: Right-click a file in the conversation to copy its path, relative path, contents, or the file itself.

theme-toggle.title: Theme toggle
theme-toggle.description: One button at the bottom of the sidebar switches light and dark, on both the browser and the desktop client.

turn-credits.title: Per-turn spend
turn-credits.description: Shows what each completed turn cost, in credits or CNY, on that reply's action row.

hide-branch.title: Hide "branch into a new conversation"
hide-branch.description: Removes the branch button from assistant messages.

sidebar-pins.title: Remember unpinned panels
sidebar-pins.description: Keeps the sidebar panels you unpinned unpinned after a restart.

rightbar-default-open.title: Right sidebar open by default
rightbar-default-open.description: Expands the right column when a session appears; left alone under 768px so it never covers the conversation.

archive-filter-toggle.title: One-click archive filter
archive-filter-toggle.description: Adds a button left of the search icon in the sidebar's Workspace header: one click flips between "hide archived" and "archived only". The glyph follows the state and a short notice confirms the switch.

approval-zh.title: Chinese approval cards
approval-zh.description: Shows the approval card headline in Chinese: DSH's own escalation and auto-review wording comes from an offline dictionary, leftover English prose goes through the built-in translator, and tool names, paths, JSON, commands and sandbox modes stay verbatim. Follows the UI language; a failed translation keeps the original text and never changes a decision.

restart-button.title: Restart button
restart-button.description: One control at the bottom of the sidebar: the first click arms it, the second ends the Host process and the container restart policy brings DSH back; the page reloads itself. Every session in this container is interrupted.

session-search.title: In-session search
session-search.description: Adds a search button left of the header's "…" menu (Ctrl/⌘+F also opens it): it highlights every match in the current session and steps through them, Enter for next and Shift+Enter for previous. Only the conversation already loaded in the page is searched.
